summary: A continued boom in late-stage and growth funding combined with a surge in seed-stage funding helped buoy venture investment in Latin America for the third quarter of 2026, Crunchbase data shows.

title: The FDE Bubble: Silicon Valley’s Most Expensive Game Of Pretend
